notes: Release 0.12 - a large driver-directed update, all verified on-car. Cockpit rail redesigned (bigger targets, the black areas act as HOME/Settings, no more tray flash, and the long-standing tile-surface-loss root cause fixed). Applications page shows driver apps only; Android Settings is behind a PIN. App store auto-lists uploaded APKs. Hands-free wake word (Hey BAIC) with an English model; voice commands decode in a chosen language and play YouTube songs directly. Clear-cache, USB welcome clip, animated BAIC X7 splash. Flying resizable keyboard with per-user languages. New Recent Calls view restores the + the vendor drops and dials international numbers back via the 00 form.
